title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. arenaria
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. arenaria, commonly known as kidney vetch or red clover, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include treating kidney and urinary tract issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of kidney vetch are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, such as isoiridin, isorhapontigenin, and kaempferol, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
